priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head d560ab90900b4dab74a78e99fbc34b9440ec6ec1, src/socket.ts:3 returns an empty disposer. The full PR diff explicitly replaces `socket.off("message", handler)` with `() => {}`, so invoking teardown leaves the registered handler active and repeated attach/dispose cycles accumulate listeners.
